segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Hello, Prakash from Thali POS. Tapaiko café ko lagi billing software khojnu bhako thiyo, right?

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Yes, hamro duita outlet cha. Internet gayo bhane billing chalcha ki chaldaina?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Chalcha, offline ma pani billing huncha, ani net aaye pachhi sync huncha.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Ani hamro accounting software sanga connect huncha?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Yes, direct integration cha accounting software sanga.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Standard plan is 2,500 per month per outlet, with yearly billing.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Hmm, duita outlet ko lagi ali dherai bhayo.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Ma tapailai pricing PDF aaja nai email gardinchu. Ani demo ko lagi next Sunday 3 baje kasto huncha?

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Yo Sunday ma milcha, diuso 3 baje.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Perfect, ma Sunday 3 baje ko demo invite pathaidinchu.
